verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֗יו וְיִנָּֽזְרוּ֙ מִקָּדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א יְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֛ים לִ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw wə·yin·nā·zə·rū miq·qā·ḏə·šê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō yə·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî ’ă·šer hêm maq·di·šîm lî ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Tell . . . Aaron . . . and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites . . . have consecrated to Me so that they do not profane My holy name I am the LORD

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם לְדֹרֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ׀ אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרַ֣ב מִכָּל־ זַרְעֲכֶ֗ם אֶל־ הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְדִּ֤ישׁוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַהִ֛וא מִלְּפָנַ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem kāl- ’îš ’ă·šer- yiq·raḇ mik·kāl zar·‘ă·ḵem ’el- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ’ă·šer yaq·dî·šū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh wə·ṭum·’ā·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mil·lə·p̄ā·nay ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Tell them that for the generations to come if any - of their descendants . . . in a state of uncleanness . . . approaches the sacred offerings that the Israelites . . . consecrate to the LORD that person must be cut off from My presence I am the LORD

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אִ֞ישׁ מִזֶּ֣רַע אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְה֤וּא צָר֙וּעַ֙ א֣וֹ זָ֔ב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים֙ לֹ֣א יֹאכַ֔ל עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְהָ֑ר וְהַנֹּגֵ֙עַ֙ בְּכָל־ טְמֵא־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־ זָֽרַע׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’îš miz·ze·ra‘ ’a·hă·rōn wə·hū ṣā·rū·a‘ ’ōw zāḇ baq·qo·ḏā·šîm lō yō·ḵal ‘aḏ ’ă·šer yiṭ·hār wə·han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·ḵāl ṭə·mê- ne·p̄eš ’ōw ’îš ’ă·šer- tê·ṣê mim·men·nū šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘
verses.literal: If a descendant . . . . . . of Aaron . . . has a skin disease or a discharge he may not eat . . . the sacred offerings until he is clean Whoever touches anything defiled by a corpse or by a man who has an emission of semen

verses.original: אוֹ־ אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגַּ֔ע בְּכָל־ שֶׁ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ ל֑וֹ א֤וֹ בְאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ ל֔וֹ לְכֹ֖ל טֻמְאָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- ’îš ’ă·šer yig·ga‘ bə·ḵāl še·reṣ ’ă·šer yiṭ·mā- lōw ’ōw ḇə·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer yiṭ·mā- lōw lə·ḵōl ṭum·’ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: or whoever touches a crawling creature - or a person that makes him unclean whatever the uncleanness may be

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע־ בּ֔וֹ וְטָמְאָ֖ה עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְלֹ֤א יֹאכַל֙ מִן־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֛י אִם־ רָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer tig·ga‘- bōw wə·ṭā·mə·’āh ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ wə·lō yō·ḵal min- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm kî ’im- rā·ḥaṣ bə·śā·rōw bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: the man who touches any of these will remain unclean until evening He must not eat from the sacred offerings unless . . . he has bathed himself with water

verses.original: וּבָ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְטָהֵ֑ר וְאַחַר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל מִן־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י לַחְמ֖וֹ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā haš·še·meš wə·ṭā·hêr wə·’a·ḥar yō·ḵal min- haq·qo·ḏā·šîm kî laḥ·mōw hū
verses.literal: When the sun has set he will become clean and then he may eat from the sacred offerings for they are his food

verses.original: נְבֵלָ֧ה וּטְרֵפָ֛ה לֹ֥א יֹאכַ֖ל לְטָמְאָה־ בָ֑הּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇê·lāh ū·ṭə·rê·p̄āh lō yō·ḵal lə·ṭā·mə·’āh- ḇāh ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals which would make him unclean I am the LORD

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא וּמֵ֥תוּ ב֖וֹ כִּ֣י יְחַלְּלֻ֑הוּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·mar·tî wə·lō- yiś·’ū ‘ā·lāw ḥêṭ ū·mê·ṯū ḇōw kî yə·ḥal·lə·lu·hū ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šām
verses.literal: The priests must keep My charge lest they bear the guilt and die because they profane it I am the LORD who sanctifies them

verses.original: וְכָל־ זָ֖ר לֹא־ יֹ֣אכַל קֹ֑דֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁ֥ב כֹּהֵ֛ן וְשָׂכִ֖יר לֹא־ יֹ֥אכַל קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl zār lō- yō·ḵal qō·ḏeš tō·wō·šaḇ kō·hên wə·śā·ḵîr lō- yō·ḵal qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering nor may the guest of a priest or his hired hand eat it

verses.original: וְכֹהֵ֗ן כִּֽי־ יִקְנֶ֥ה נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ קִנְיַ֣ן כַּסְפּ֔וֹ ה֖וּא יֹ֣אכַל בּ֑וֹ וִילִ֣יד בֵּית֔וֹ הֵ֖ם יֹאכְל֥וּ בְלַחְמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵō·hên kî- yiq·neh ne·p̄eš qin·yan kas·pōw hū yō·ḵal bōw wî·lîḏ bê·ṯōw hêm yō·ḵə·lū ḇə·laḥ·mōw
verses.literal: But if a priest buys a slave with his own money or if a slave is born in his household that slave may eat his food

verses.original: וּבַת־ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ זָ֑ר הִ֕וא בִּתְרוּמַ֥ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaṯ- kō·hên kî ṯih·yeh lə·’îš zār hî biṯ·rū·maṯ haq·qo·ḏā·šîm lō ṯō·ḵêl
verses.literal: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest she is not to eat of the sacred contributions

verses.original: וּבַת־ כֹּהֵן֩ כִּ֨י תִהְיֶ֜ה אַלְמָנָ֣ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֗ה וְזֶרַע֮ אֵ֣ין לָהּ֒ וְשָׁבָ֞ה אֶל־ בֵּ֤ית אָבִ֙יהָ֙ כִּנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ מִלֶּ֥חֶם אָבִ֖יהָ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וְכָל־ זָ֖ר לֹא־ יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaṯ- kō·hên kî ṯih·yeh ’al·mā·nāh ū·ḡə·rū·šāh wə·ze·ra‘ ’ên lāh wə·šā·ḇāh ’el- bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·hā kin·‘ū·re·hā mil·le·ḥem ’ā·ḇî·hā tō·ḵêl wə·ḵāl zār lō- yō·ḵal bōw
verses.literal: But if a priest’s daughter with no children becomes widowed or divorced and returns to her father’s house she may share her father’s food as in her youth But no . . . outsider may share it

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־ יֹאכַ֥ל קֹ֖דֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְיָסַ֤ף חֲמִֽשִׁיתוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנָתַ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־ הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî- yō·ḵal qō·ḏeš biš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mi·šî·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw wə·nā·ṯan lak·kō·hên ’eṯ- haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: If anyone eats a sacred offering in error he must add a fifth to its value and give the sacred offering to the priest

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ יָרִ֖ימוּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yə·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yā·rî·mū Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priests must not profane the sacred offerings that the Israelites . . . - present to the LORD

verses.original: וְהִשִּׂ֤יאוּ אוֹתָם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אַשְׁמָ֔ה בְּאָכְלָ֖ם אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiś·śî·’ū ’ō·w·ṯām ‘ă·wōn ’aš·māh bə·’ā·ḵə·lām ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šê·hem kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šām
verses.literal: by allowing the people to eat the sacred offerings and thus to bear the punishment for guilt For I am the LORD who sanctifies them

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־ הַגֵּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ לְכָל־ נִדְרֵיהֶם֙ וּלְכָל־ נִדְבוֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw wə·’el kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’îš ’îš mib·bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·min- hag·gêr bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yaq·rîḇ qā·rə·bā·nōw lə·ḵāl niḏ·rê·hem ū·lə·ḵāl- niḏ·ḇō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer- yaq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh lə·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: Speak to Aaron . . . and his sons . . . and all the Israelites . . . and tell them Any man . . . of the house of Israel or any foreign resident who presents a gift . . . for a burnt offering to the LORD whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering

verses.original: לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם תָּמִ֣ים זָכָ֔ר בַּבָּקָ֕ר בַּכְּשָׂבִ֖ים וּבָֽעִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lir·ṣō·nə·ḵem tā·mîm zā·ḵār bab·bā·qār bak·kə·śā·ḇîm ū·ḇā·‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: must offer an unblemished male from the cattle sheep or goats in order for it to be accepted on your behalf

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א תַקְרִ֑יבוּ כִּי־ לֹ֥א לְרָצ֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ’ă·šer- bōw mūm lō ṯaq·rî·ḇū kî- lō lə·rā·ṣō·wn yih·yeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not present anything with a defect because it will not be accepted on your behalf

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־ יַקְרִ֤יב זֶֽבַח־ שְׁלָמִים֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לְפַלֵּא־ נֶ֙דֶר֙ א֣וֹ לִנְדָבָ֔ה בַּבָּקָ֖ר א֣וֹ בַצֹּ֑אן תָּמִ֤ים יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְרָצ֔וֹן כָּל־ מ֖וּם לֹ֥א יִהְיֶה־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî- yaq·rîḇ ze·ḇaḥ- šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh lə·p̄al·lê- ne·ḏer ’ōw lin·ḏā·ḇāh bab·bā·qār ’ōw ḇaṣ·ṣōn tā·mîm yih·yeh lə·rā·ṣō·wn kāl- mūm lō yih·yeh- bōw
verses.literal: When a man presents a peace offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering it must be without blemish - or defect to be acceptable

verses.original: עַוֶּרֶת֩ א֨וֹ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ־ חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ־ יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת לֹא־ תַקְרִ֥יבוּ אֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְאִשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־ תִתְּנ֥וּ מֵהֶ֛ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aw·we·reṯ ’ōw šā·ḇūr ’ōw- ḥā·rūṣ ’ōw- yab·be·leṯ ’ōw ḡā·rāḇ ’ōw yal·le·p̄eṯ lō- ṯaq·rî·ḇū ’êl·leh Yah·weh wə·’iš·šeh lō- ṯit·tə·nū mê·hem ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are not to present to the LORD any animal that is blind injured or maimed . . . or anything with a running sore . . . a festering rash . . . or a scab you must not put any of these on the altar as a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: וְשׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֖ה שָׂר֣וּעַ וְקָל֑וּט נְדָבָה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וּלְנֵ֖דֶר לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·wr wā·śeh śā·rū·a‘ wə·qā·lūṭ nə·ḏā·ḇāh ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯōw ū·lə·nê·ḏer lō yê·rā·ṣeh
verses.literal: You may present as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow

verses.original: וּמָע֤וּךְ וְכָתוּת֙ וְנָת֣וּק וְכָר֔וּת לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֖יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּֽבְאַרְצְכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·‘ūḵ wə·ḵā·ṯūṯ wə·nā·ṯūq wə·ḵā·rūṯ lō ṯaq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh ū·ḇə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem lō ṯa·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: You are not to present to the LORD an animal whose testicles are bruised crushed torn or cut you are not to sacrifice them in your land

verses.original: וּמִיַּ֣ד בֶּן־ נֵכָ֗ר לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת־ לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י מָשְׁחָתָ֤ם בָּהֶם֙ מ֣וּם בָּ֔ם לֹ֥א יֵרָצ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mî·yaḏ ben- nê·ḵār lō ṯaq·rî·ḇū ’eṯ- le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem mik·kāl ’êl·leh kî mā·šə·ḥā·ṯām bā·hem mūm bām lō yê·rā·ṣū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Neither you nor a foreigner . . . shall present food to your God from any such animal They will not be accepted on your behalf because they are deformed and flawed

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־ כֶ֤שֶׂב אוֹ־ עֵז֙ כִּ֣י יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֛ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת אִמּ֑וֹ וּמִיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ וָהָ֔לְאָה יֵרָצֶ֕ה לְקָרְבַּ֥ן אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šō·wr ’ōw- ḵe·śeḇ ’ōw- ‘êz kî yiw·wā·lêḏ wə·hā·yāh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ta·ḥaṯ ’im·mōw ū·mî·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî wā·hā·lə·’āh yê·rā·ṣeh lə·qā·rə·ban ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: When an ox a sheep . . . or a goat is born it must remain with its mother for seven days From the eighth day on it will be acceptable as a food offering presented to the LORD

verses.original: וְשׁ֖וֹר אוֹ־ שֶׂ֑ה אֹת֣וֹ וְאֶת־ בְּנ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִשְׁחֲט֖וּ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·wr ’ōw- śeh ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- bə·nōw lō ṯiš·ḥă·ṭū bə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: But you must not slaughter an ox or a sheep - on the same day as its young

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ תִזְבְּח֥וּ זֶֽבַח־ תּוֹדָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯiz·bə·ḥū ze·ḇaḥ- tō·w·ḏāh Yah·weh lir·ṣō·nə·ḵem tiz·bā·ḥū
verses.literal: When you sacrifice a thank offering to the LORD offer it so that it may be acceptable on your behalf

verses.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־ בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yê·’ā·ḵêl lō- ṯō·w·ṯî·rū mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: It must be eaten that same day Do not leave any of it until morning I am the LORD

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem miṣ·wō·ṯay wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are to keep My commandments and practice them I am the LORD

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֔י וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯə·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî wə·niq·daš·tî bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·diš·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not profane My holy name I must be acknowledged as holy among the Israelites . . . I am the LORD who sanctifies you

verses.original: הַמּוֹצִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ham·mō·w·ṣî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lih·yō·wṯ lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God I am the LORD
